title: Timely Crafts: Modded Edition
description: Modpack that focuses on Cobblemon and Create, with exploration aspects and other QoL features
body:
This is a modpack I set up for my friends who wanted to mess around with Cobblemon and Create. Thus, the main mods in it are Cobblemon and Create as well as addons for both to expand their functionality and some other QoL mods. In the end, the pack is based on our shared interests so this pack is not balanced around any particular difficulty or playstyle. Expect to mostly focus on Cobblemon and Create while exploring the world and taking on dungeons.

This modpack is based on NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1.

**I claim no rights to the content of this pack. Please refer to the original mods' license if you wish to learn more.**
